Jordan (CEO): Quick heads-up: all-hands moved to Thursday 9:30am PT, 45min. Draft agenda below — add Qs or items by EOD Wed. we'll lock and send calendar update. :mega:

Jordan (CEO): AGENDA (draft)
```
- 8m: CEO & biz update (growth + churn)
- 12m: Product spotlight feature launch callout + roadmap shifts
- 10m: Reliability recap recent incident + mitigations
- 8m: Sales highlight + customer win shoutout
- 7m: People Ops updates + recognition
- Q&A (rest of time)
```

Mina (Product): Can we make the product spotlight include the new Canary rollout plan? Need a short public-facing blurb and internal rollout timeline.

Ravi (Eng): For reliability recap I can summarize the slow tail latency regressions and the traffic patterns that triggered them. Will bring the latency percentiles slide.

Tess (SRE): Also want to mention the new circuit-breaker rule we added last week and how it'll affect retries. short note on observability changes.

Ibrahim (Sales): Customer win: Longview (Fintech) signed Dedicated contract. Can we include a 60s shoutout and the logo on the slide?

Jordan (CEO): Great. Mina, please draft the external blurb (1-2 lines) and post here. We'll include the internal rollout timeline separate. Ibrahim, we'll add Longview shoutout in the Sales segment.

notify-bot: calendar updated: "Company All-Hands" Thu 9:30am PT. Zoom link in event. Reminder 10m prior.

Jules (People Ops): Adding quick recognition segment. If you have peers to highlight, drop a name + 1 line here and I'll read 3 of them live. :sparkles:

Mina (Product): External blurb draft: "We're launching Dedicated Canary: reserved pools with predictable latency and opt-in rollout for enterprise workloads. Starting next month for new Dedicated customers." Thoughts?

Jordan (CEO): Clean. Add a pointer to SLA FAQ for customers and an internal doc link for the rollout plan.

Ravi (Eng): Q: will the canary require model pinning? that impacts how we route requests.

Mina (Product): Yes, initial canary requires a pinned model version on the reserved pool; we'll explain limitations in the rollout doc.

--- meeting occurs ---

Jordan (CEO): POST: Thanks all for joining. Recording: https://zoom.redwood.example/rec/def456 (available 60 days). Quick recap below.

Jordan (CEO): HIGHLIGHTS:
- Biz: ARR growth +12% q/q; churn improved after billings changes.
- Product: Dedicated Canary announced; will begin opt-in rollouts next month. External blurb posted.
- Reliability: incident was due to bursty synthesis requests causing KV cache thrash; mitigations pushed (shorter cache TTL and adaptive batching).
- Sales: Longview deal closed documentation and onboarding starts next week.
- People: 8 hires starting in July; recognition: @Ravi for oncall work, @Mina for product push, @Sam for design help.

Jordan (CEO): ACTIONS (owners + due dates):
- Mina: publish rollout doc + internal FAQ (due 4 business days).
- Ravi & Tess: final incident RCA + postmortem (due 2 business days).
- Ibrahim: share Longview onboarding checklist in #customer-success (due 1 business day).
- Jules: post recognition thread & new hires list (due EOD tomorrow).

Mina (Product): I'll also gluing the SLA FAQ with Finance and will ping here when it's live.

Ravi (Eng): RCA draft pushed to #postmortems: https://slack.redwood.example/postmortems/RC-2026-05. Will update with traces.

Tess (SRE): Circuit-breaker config PR is open: https://git.redwood.example/p/sre/circuit-breaker (link to config + tests).

Ibrahim (Sales): Longview press co-ordination: will loop in comms and get logo approval.

Jules (People Ops): Recognition thread: https://slack.redwood.example/archives/CKX12/recognize-456 drop your kudos there.

Jordan (CEO): If anyone asked a Q that didn't get answered live, drop it here. We'll triage and follow up. Appreciate everyone who joined. :handshake:"
